_provenance:
Parametric atom forms of four (AA|AB) hybrids, one positive symbol u per exponent region, built 2026-11-19 by running geovac.two_center_eri.hybrid_closed_form_shell's algebra with symbolic exponents (per-orbital normalisation dropped) and collected exactly into atoms; copied verbatim (fields info, form) from that run's output. Key format of form: (c, kind, kappa, [(constant, exponent)]), kind '1' | 'log' | 'Ei' (E1(kR) = -Ei(-kR)); constants GAM = Euler gamma, PI, LOG: = ln x, P:

= p. Region maps: lt a_d = 1, a_c = 1 + u; mid a_p = 1 + u, a_d = a_c + u; gt a_c = 1, a_d = 1 + a_p/a_c + u; eq1 a_d = a_c; eq2 a_d = a_c + a_p.
